notes: Thresholds for Stage analysis. Change a number here, or a rule in jobs/stages.py, and bump the version. v2: a stage change must hold for 5 days, and price below a still-rising average is Stage 3.
_confirm: A different stage must hold for 5 trading days before it replaces the current one. Without this a share crossing its average daily flips stage every few days.
_rising: 30-week average up 2%+ over the last 10 weeks counts as rising; down 2%+ as falling; in between is flat.

stage2._comment: Advancing: above a rising 30-week average, within 25% of the 52-week high, and not among the weakest stocks. Being above the average alone is NOT Stage 2.

_stage3: Topping needs no threshold of its own: it is what is left when the advance stalls - the average flattens, or price slips below an average that is still rising.

stage1._comment: Basing: flat 30-week average, price stuck in a range near its lows. Watch, do not buy.
